description:
Retrieve the voices your organization can use, with filtering and
pagination. Use `provider=featured` for OmniDimension voices, the
recommended starting point, in the order the dashboard shows them.
Cartesia voices are the next choice.

Each voice keeps its own `service`: save that as the agent's voice
provider. A provider your organization cannot use returns a 400.
Cartesia and ElevenLabs support filtering by name, language, accent,
and gender. Other providers support pagination only.

(Tags: Providers)

gender.description: Filter voices by gender. Cartesia and ElevenLabs.

language.description: ISO language code (e.g. `en`, `hi`, `es`). Cartesia and ElevenLabs.

provider.description:
Provider to list voices from. Omit to list every voice your organization can use.
`featured` lists OmniDimension voices and is the recommended choice, followed by
`cartesia`. A provider your organization cannot use returns a 400.

search.description: Substring match against voice name or description. Cartesia and ElevenLabs.

name: listVoices
